entries.question: How does RadzenDataGrid page on the server and report the total count?
entries.query: RadzenDataGrid LoadData server-side paging with Count, IsLoading and EmptyText for TItem CustomerSummary (Id, Name, City)
entries.summary: LoadData(LoadDataArgs) is raised for paging/sorting/filtering; bind Data to the current page and Count to the total; IsLoading shows the loading indicator; EmptyText sets the no-data message; FirstPage(forceReload) returns to page 1 and reloads.

entries.question: Which RadzenTextBox event fires once when the value is committed?
entries.query: RadzenTextBox Change event vs @oninput, with @bind-Value, inside RadzenFormField
entries.summary: Change (EventCallback<string>) fires when the value is committed (blur/Enter); @bind-Value keeps the value in sync; RadzenFormField Text renders the visible label.

entries.question: Which LoadDataArgs members carry the requested page?
entries.query: Radzen LoadDataArgs Skip Top nullable paging values
entries.summary: Skip and Top are nullable ints with the requested offset and page size.
